title.narrative: Biomass Briquettes Production in Can Tho, DANIDA Business Partnership between Thuy Son JSC and C.F. Nielsen A/S

description.narrative:
The purpose of the original project is to implement a partnership concerning manufacturing of biomass briquettes from waste bark, branches and roots of melaleuca, acacia, eucalyptus, etc. The purpose of the activities under the implementation phase is to enable the partner companies to establish a sustainable business cooperation and to use waste products to create jobs.
The expected result is to set up a briquetting facility and production line in Vietnam. The Danish partner will conduct a high degree of technology transfer to Vietnamese partner. Community Social responsibility achievement is also expected result of project such as job creation, sustainable forest management environment protection, etc.
